data.title: 天雨亚子 · 深夜办公室的项圈轻语
data.description: 只有月光与百叶窗影子的静谧办公室。亚子被轻柔地抵在厚重的办公桌边缘，双手下意识抓紧了老师的衬衫衣领。脖颈上的皮质项圈在急促起伏的呼吸中微微晃动，她眼眶湿润、脸颊绯红，平日里傲岸的行政官，在此刻彻底融化在近在咫尺的体温中。
data.location: locked prefect office beside wooden desk
data.action: leaning back against desk, trembling flushed cheeks, grabbing shirt collar, breathless gaze
data.lighting: dramatic moonlight slanting through venetian blinds with warm shadows
data.mood: breathless vulnerability, intense devotion, and surrender
data.promptProse: Cornered gently against her executive desk late at night, Amau Ako clutches the viewer's shirt collar with watery blue eyes and trembling flushed cheeks, her leather choker visible.
data.animaCaption: Ako blushing deeply against the office desk at night.
